Subject: Expanding to two more product teams — timing & terms

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We had an internal sync this morning and two additional product teams (Checkout & Merchandising) want to onboard next quarter. High level ask:

- 4 additional API keys (one per new project + one staging)
- Dedicated throughput target: ~600 req/min across the account during peak
- Prefer to consolidate under the current annual agreement, but open to a short-term amendment for Q1 usage spikes

 Can you outline the simplest path: pricing delta, provisioning timeline, and any contractual steps (amendment or addendum)? Procurement copied on this thread is procurement@northbridge.com.

Appreciate a short plan we can take to our finance/ops folks.

Best,
Jenna Ortiz
Head of Platform Partnerships
NorthBridge Retail

Subject: Re: Expanding to two more product teams — timing & terms

Jenna — thanks for the clear summary, and glad the teams are ready to move. Quick summary of the practical path below (will follow up with an itemized amendment + SOW):

1) Keys & provisioning
   - We can issue 4 additional API keys within 48 hours once we get the list of project names and owners. We'll use our provisioning template to capture allowed origins, quotas, and environments.

2) Capacity & SLAs
   - For the 600 req/min peak, we recommend small dedicated burst pool + autoscaling policy to keep 95th pct latency under your current SLO. Cost for the burst capacity is estimated ~ +18% on top of current committed spend for Q1.

3) Contractual approach
   - Option A (recommended): one short-term addendum through 2027-03-31 that increases reserved capacity for Q1 and codifies the additional keys.
   - Option B: temporary overage billing for Q1, then fold into renewal pricing in the annual renewal.

Next steps I suggest: I. I’ll share a draft addendum + updated SOW today, II. Marcus will validate the autoscale settings + quota template, III. Evelyn will coordinate onboarding docs and enablement slots for the new teams.

If that plan works I’ll drop the draft addendum and a provisioning CSV for your ops team to fill in.

Thanks — Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.example.com | +1 415-555-0172

[inline: timeline: addendum draft by 12/12, keys provisioned by 12/14 after CSV receipt]

From: marcus_lin@redwood.example.com

Subject: Re: NorthBridge expansion — capacity & keys

Lauren / Evelyn — quick technical notes for the addendum and provisioning template: 

- Autoscale: recommend min_pool=2 gpus, burst_pool=1 additional node type (T4-equivalent) that spins up at sustained 400 req/min for 2 minutes. This gives a cushion for your 600 req/min peaks without long startup latency.
- KV caching: enable per-project prefix caching to reduce token cost for Catalog lookups — expect 20–30% token cost drop for Checkout flows.
- Quota template: will attach a CSV with columns: project_name, owner_email, environment, allowed_origins, monthly_token_cap. Fill these and return.

I attached the CSV template. Once filled we can generate keys and stitch the routing rules so the new projects hit the dedicated pool.

Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
